_about: Tiles-for-a-mat ranking (FYM 1.18, builder/fym_fix_nov07/tilerank_v118.py, gate [168]). Tiffany Nov 7 10:33pm: Lotus Cove's mat door showed Halloween tile sets ~10 deep. backs: tile BACK colours for the visible sets that have no confirmed back in config/tableview-back-colors.json (that file always wins; these are Claude's by-eye reads of the FYM tile photo, Nov 7, used ONLY for ranking, never for Table view walls). themed: non-holiday seasonal/themed tile sets (go to the bottom for every mat that does not share the theme); holiday tile sets come from the page's BACKG.Holiday. not_themed: sets whose name hits a theme word but are year-round. motifs: extra name motifs (on top of config/fym-motifs-oct26.json) for the motif bonus, which only applies when the colours already fit (Tiffany Nov 7 8:07pm).
